acceptanceCriteria: README and install/automation entry points state when either ledger can be written, and a read-only operator can distinguish those writes from ranking/evidence/trace mutation.
body:
Comprehensive expert audit 2026-09-26, DOC-02. Source 2961076fc0b78bfab743578f2ef5c17006be058a.

README says 'Read commands change nothing' and advertises mutates:false, but help and invariant 4 permit a bounded self-observation append on unsupported refusals and an opt-in unplanned-read ledger during host hooks. Operators who audit repository bytes could see a permitted `.corvint` write after a read failure or hook event despite the headline.

Source: README.md:25; README.md:50; AGENTS.md:13; cmd/corvint/help.go:351; docs/AUTOMATION.md:35; docs/specs/unplanned-read-events-v0.md:65

Observed checks: "Source and command help checked; no ledger mutation was performed in the audit checkout. Existing tests in cmd/corvint/main_test.go:177 and cmd/corvint/host_adapter_test.go:365 exercise the exception."

Owning contract: "AGENTS.md invariant 4; SOL-V0-001/007/010 and URE-V0-003/004."

Correction: Qualify the README sentence with the exact bounded private-ledger exceptions and opt-in marker; retain mutates:false semantics as stated by each command profile.

Report: .agent-evidence/2026-09-26-comprehensive-audit.md; original reports and evidence: .agent-evidence/audit-20260926/. Focused checks plus independent review are required for repair; any native release qualification needs the selected candidate and owner-dispatched run. No qualification or promotion is implied by this ticket.
title: README read-only headline omits the two allowed local ledger writes
